profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | Scalable Systems | AI/ML Explorer
profile.summary:
Lead Full Stack Software Engineer with 15+ years experience building robust, scalable systems that solve complex business problems.

● 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐕𝐚𝐥𝐮𝐞: I thrive in ambiguity, translating high-level goals into actionable technical roadmaps. I bridge the gap between complex backend logic and intuitive UI/UX design, ensuring that even the most sophisticated systems remain user-centric and accessible.
● 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡: Passionate about the cutting edge—from modern web frameworks to the evolving AI landscape.
● 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐚𝐥: Partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver innovative, modern solutions that move the needle for the business.

𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗟𝗮𝗻𝗴𝘂𝗮𝗴𝗲𝘀 & 𝗟𝗼𝗴𝗶𝗰 
𝗟𝗮𝗻𝗴𝘂𝗮𝗴𝗲𝘀: JavaScript (TypeScript), Python, Java, C#, SQL 
𝗔𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲: Scalable System Design, Distributed Systems, RESTful APIs, ETL Pipelines

𝗔𝗜 & 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 
𝗢𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: LangChain, LangGraph, Autonomous Agents 
𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: Ollama, Local LLMs (Llama), Claude, API Gateway 
𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹𝘀 & 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Claude, OpenAI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

𝗙𝗿𝗼𝗻𝘁-𝗘𝗻𝗱 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 
𝗙𝗿𝗮𝗺𝗲𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝘀: React, Redux, Astro, AngularJs 
𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻 & 𝗨𝗫: UI/UX Architecture, Responsive Design, User-Centric Dashboards, Wireframing
𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀 & 𝗧𝗼𝗼𝗹𝘀: SSR, WCAG Accessibility, Vite, Webpack

𝗕𝗮𝗰𝗸-𝗘𝗻𝗱 & 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗢𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 
𝗥𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀: Node.js (Express), .NET Core, Java JAX-RS 
𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮: MongoDB, MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis

𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱 & 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗢𝗽𝘀 
𝗣𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺: AWS, Azure, Docker, GitHub, CI/CD 
𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀: Agile (Scrum/Kanban), Jira, Power BI

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
● 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩: Co-lead a team of 5 engineers managing front-end operations for HP Inc.’s global eCommerce platform, serving as a primary technical liaison between Engineering and Business stakeholders.

● 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠: Spearheaded web performance initiatives using SSR, code splitting, and lazy loading, maintaining high-availability and optimal API performance for a high-traffic enterprise ecosystem.

● 𝐀𝐠𝐢𝐥𝐞 𝐄𝐱𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Bridge the gap between business vision and technical delivery, architecting and shipping complex features on a high-velocity, two-week sprint cadence.

● 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐎𝐩𝐬 & 𝐌𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩: Oversee the CI/CD pipeline to ensure 100% deployment reliability while mentoring junior developers through rigorous code reviews and architectural workshops.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
● 𝐃𝐢𝐠𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Contracted by HP Inc. as Front-End Technical Lead to assist and architect the foundation for their modern enterprise eCommerce platform.

● 𝐋𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐜𝐲 𝐌𝐢𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Co-led the high-stakes migration from legacy systems to a modern MERN stack, enabling real-time platform agility for Global Sales and Marketing teams.

● 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐎𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Reduced page load times by 66% (12s → 4s) and First Contentful Paint by 80% (4s → 0.8s) leading to higher customer engagement rates.

● 𝐑𝐚𝐩𝐢𝐝 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐭 𝐃𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲: Re-engineered a mission-critical legacy "Supplies Finder" tool from the ground up in under 30 days to prevent revenue loss due to expiring third-party licenses.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
● 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚 𝐀𝐮𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Architected automated data pipelines using Python and Pandas, successfully decommissioning manual ETL processes and increasing engineering bandwidth by automating repetitive data tasks.

● 𝐁𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞: Drove enterprise-wide adoption of Power BI, replacing legacy reporting tools with self-service dashboards that empowered non-technical stakeholders to access real-time insights.

● 𝐎𝐫𝐠𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Served as a technical anchor during the PAAMCO and Prisma merger, ensuring data continuity and system stability during the consolidation of PNEXTGEN.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer (PNEXTGEN)
positions.description:
(PNEXTGEN was a PAAMCO software company)

● 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐭 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭: Led front end development in a team of 6 to build a flagship FinTech SaaS platform from $0 to launch, enabling institutional investors to track fund performance within private Azure environments.

● 𝐅𝐮𝐥𝐥-𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐀𝐫𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞: Co-architected a hybrid RESTful API using Java JAX-RS and Azure Active Directory for secure, multi-tenant data access.

● 𝐅𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐈𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Engineered complex React/Redux dashboards featuring a decoupled JS engine for real-time data visualization (D3.js, Highcharts, ag-Grid).

● 𝐃𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐜 𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠: Designed a custom system for dynamic DAX query generation based on UI interactions, optimizing data retrieval from the enterprise data warehouse.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐜 𝐈𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬: Directed the design and delivery of high-profile, company-wide software systems that digitized manual business workflows.

● 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭: Combined hands-on engineering with active requirement gathering, fostering cross-functional collaboration between developers and executive leadership.

projects.title: Autonomous Agent Teams
projects.description: Architecting a localized, LLM-driven development pipeline using Node.js, Ollama, RAG, and vector databases. Engineered containerized "expert" AI agents with automated Git integration that dynamically fetch code across branches, autonomously plan and execute feature development, and generate pull requests for human review.
